about.ex: Producers are worried about the funding cut.

business.ex: Local business groups welcomed the plan.

call.ex: There is a growing call for cheaper buses.

cap.ex: The cap on tickets will be lifted.

capital.en: the main city of a country

cautioned.ex: Experts cautioned that prices could rise.

certainty.en: being sure about what will happen

charge.en: an amount of money people must pay

chief.ex: The police chief spoke to the press.

commitment.ex: The party made a commitment to cut taxes.

noteEs.exampleTr: La ciudad se comprometió a plantar más árboles.

noteHi.exampleTr: शहर ने और पेड़ लगाने की प्रतिबद्धता जताई।

noteJa.exampleTr: 市はもっと木を植えると約束した。
noteJa.usage: make a commitment to (doing) の形。

consumers.en: people who buy goods and services

contending.ex: She is contending that the rules are unfair.

contingent.ex: The deal is contingent upon funding.

example.en: The offer is contingent upon a good report.

note.usage: 固定搭配 be contingent upon/on sth，等於 depend on，屬正式用法。

noteEs.exampleTr: La oferta está supeditada a un buen informe.

noteHi.exampleTr: यह प्रस्ताव अच्छी रिपोर्ट पर निर्भर है।

noteJa.exampleTr: その申し出は良い報告次第だ。
noteJa.usage: be contingent upon/on 〜 は depend on の硬い言い方。

contributes.en: gives something to help a shared project

cost.en: to need an amount of money

disney.en: a large US media and film company

disproportionate.en: too large compared with something else

example.zh: 低收入家庭承擔了不成比例的能源成本。

note.usage: 常見 a disproportionate share/impact/number；後接 to。

noteEn.meaning: too large compared with something else.

noteEs.exampleTr: Las familias con bajos ingresos soportan una parte desproporcionada del coste energético.
noteEs.meaning: desproporcionado; excesivo en relación con algo.
noteEs.usage: Común: a disproportionate share/impact; seguido de to.

noteHi.exampleTr: कम आय वाले परिवार ऊर्जा लागत का असमान रूप से बड़ा हिस्सा उठाते हैं।
noteHi.usage: a disproportionate share/impact आम प्रयोग है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 低所得世帯はエネルギー費の不釣り合いな負担を負っている。
noteJa.usage: a disproportionate share/impact の形が多い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 저소득 가정이 에너지 비용을 불균형적으로 많이 부담한다.

evidence.en: information given to an official group

excess.ex: The bill came to in excess of a thousand euro.

executive.ex: The executive spoke to the press.

existing.ex: We will improve the existing system.

expenditure.ex: Public expenditure on health rose last year.

example.zh: 家庭的食品支出上升了。

note.usage: 比 spending 正式；public/household expenditure；expenditure on sth。

noteEs.exampleTr: El gasto de los hogares en comida ha subido.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que spending; expenditure on algo.

noteHi.exampleTr: भोजन पर घरेलू व्यय बढ़ा है।
noteHi.usage: spending से औपचारिक; expenditure on sth।

noteJa.exampleTr: 家計の食費支出が増えた。

far.ex: The new road is far better than the old one.

fee.ex: There is a small fee to enter.

fees.en: money paid for a professional service

felt.ex: The effects of the storm were felt across the county.

film.en: movies as an art or industry

for.en: intended to belong to or help

freedom.en: the right to act or speak without control

fulfil.en: do what was promised or required

example.zh: 議會未能兌現興建新公園的承諾。

note.meaning: 履行（承諾、義務）；實現（目標）。
note.usage: 常接 promise / commitment / obligation / role；美式拼作 fulfill。

noteEn.meaning: to do what you promised or must do.

noteEs.exampleTr: El ayuntamiento no cumplió su promesa de nuevos parques.
noteEs.usage: Con promise/commitment/obligation; en EE. UU. se escribe fulfill.

noteHi.exampleTr: परिषद नए पार्कों का वादा पूरा नहीं कर सकी।
noteHi.usage: promise/commitment/obligation के साथ; अमेरिकी वर्तनी fulfill।

noteJa.exampleTr: 議会は新しい公園を造るという約束を果たせなかった。
noteJa.meaning: （約束・義務を）果たす、履行する。
noteJa.usage: promise / commitment / obligation と結びつく。米綴りは fulfill。

noteKo.exampleTr: 의회는 새 공원을 짓겠다는 약속을 지키지 못했다.
noteKo.usage: promise/commitment/obligation과 함께 쓴다. 미국식 철자는 fulfill.

fundamental.ex: There is a fundamental problem with the plan.

further.ex: She further said the plan was too costly.

furthermore.ex: Furthermore, the plan is too costly.

future.ex: Young people care about the future of the planet.

giants.ex: Tech giants face new EU rules.

give.ex: The plan will give the town a new park.

given.ex: Given the cost, the plan was dropped.

gives.ex: The plan gives more money to schools.

government.en: the people who run a country

ground.en: ground to a halt: slowly stopped completely

group.en: people who meet or work together

grown.ex: The town has grown a lot since 2000.

growth.en: an increase in size or amount

halt.ex: The project came to a halt last year.

hardest.ex: Rising prices hit poor families hardest.

has.en: owns; also used to form perfect tenses

have.en: own; also used to form perfect tenses

heads.en: leads or is in charge of

heard.en: was told during a formal meeting

hits.ex: The storm hits the coast tonight.

honour.ex: The company must honour its contracts.

impact.ex: The strike had a big impact on schools.

independent.en: not controlled by the company or government

introduce.en: to start using a new system

irish.en: from Ireland (The Irish Times: 報紙名)

keep.en: continue or hold at a level

large.ex: They took out a large loan.

last.ex: We went to Spain last summer.

example.zh: 議會對塑膠袋開徵一項稅費。

note.meaning: 名詞指政府徵收的稅或費；動詞指徵收（稅款）。
note.usage: 常見 a levy on + 課稅對象；動詞 levy a tax on sth.。

noteEs.exampleTr: El ayuntamiento introdujo un gravamen sobre las bolsas de plástico.
noteEs.meaning: Impuesto o cargo oficial; como verbo, imponer un impuesto.
noteEs.usage: Se dice 'a levy on' algo; verbo: 'levy a tax on'.

noteHi.exampleTr: परिषद ने प्लास्टिक थैलों पर शुल्क लगाया।
noteHi.meaning: सरकार द्वारा लगाया गया कर या शुल्क; क्रिया के रूप में कर लगाना।
noteHi.usage: a levy on + वस्तु; क्रिया: levy a tax on something।

noteJa.exampleTr: 議会はレジ袋に課徴金を導入した。
noteJa.meaning: 政府が課す税や負担金。動詞では「（税を）課す」。
noteJa.usage: a levy on + 対象。動詞は levy a tax on ～。

noteKo.usage: a levy on + 대상; 동사는 levy a tax on ~.

media.en: TV, radio, newspapers and the internet

million.ex: The city has over one million people.

ms.en: title before a woman's family name

national.ex: The national office is in Dublin.

not.ex: The shop is not open today.

platforms.en: online services where people watch or share content

predictable.en: able to be known in advance

example.zh: 這個鎮的人口以年輕人為主。

note.usage: 比 mainly 更正式，常修飾形容詞或過去分詞，如 predominantly rural。

noteEs.exampleTr: La población del pueblo es mayoritariamente joven.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que mainly; p. ej., predominantly rural.

noteHi.exampleTr: इस शहर की आबादी मुख्य रूप से युवा है।
noteHi.usage: mainly से अधिक औपचारिक; predominantly rural जैसा प्रयोग।

noteJa.exampleTr: その町の人口は主に若者だ。
noteJa.usage: mainly より改まった語。predominantly rural など。

noteKo.exampleTr: 그 마을의 인구는 주로 젊은 층이다.
noteKo.usage: mainly보다 격식 있는 말; predominantly rural 등.

pressing.en: strongly asking someone to do something

prices.en: amounts of money paid for things

production.en: the making of films or TV programmes

programmes.ex: Children's programmes are shown in the morning.

radio.en: programmes you listen to, not watch

raised.ex: The town raised parking fees this year.

recent.ex: The most recent survey shows a change.

reduction.ex: There was a reduction in bus fares.

regardless.ex: The match will go ahead regardless of the weather.

regional.ex: The regional hospital serves three counties.

regions.ex: Some regions are poorer than others.

reiterated.ex: She reiterated her support for the plan.

noteEs.exampleTr: La ministra reiteró su apoyo al plan.
noteEs.usage: Más formal que repeat: reiterate a call/position.

noteHi.exampleTr: मंत्री ने योजना के लिए अपना समर्थन दोहराया।

noteJa.exampleTr: 大臣は計画への支持を改めて表明した。
noteJa.meaning: 繰り返し述べた；再表明した。
noteJa.usage: reiterate a call/position など公式発言で使う。

noteKo.exampleTr: 장관은 그 계획에 대한 지지를 재차 밝혔다.
noteKo.usage: reiterate a call/position 등 공식 발언에 쓴다.

relief.ex: First-time buyers can claim tax relief.

renewed.ex: Residents renewed their demand for a new bridge.

repercussions.en: effects, often bad, that follow an action

example.zh: 工廠關閉對整個鎮都造成了影響。

note.usage: 多用複數；have repercussions for/on sb/sth；比 effects 更正式。

noteEs.exampleTr: El cierre de la fábrica tuvo repercusiones para todo el pueblo.
noteEs.meaning: consecuencias, normalmente negativas, que se extienden.
noteEs.usage: Suele ir en plural; have repercussions for/on.

noteHi.exampleTr: कारख़ाना बंद होने का असर पूरे शहर पर पड़ा।
noteHi.meaning: किसी कार्य के (अक्सर बुरे) परिणाम जो बाद में फैलते हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 工場の閉鎖は町全体に影響を及ぼした。
noteJa.usage: 通常複数形。have repercussions for/on ～。effects より硬い。

noteKo.exampleTr: 공장 폐쇄는 마을 전체에 여파를 미쳤다.
noteKo.usage: 보통 복수형; have repercussions for/on ~. effects보다 격식적.

revived.en: brought back to life or use

ripple.ex: The news rippled through the small town.

rose.ex: House prices rose again last year.

rté.zh: 愛爾蘭國家廣播電視台

screen.en: film and television as an industry

sector.en: one part of the economy or business
sector.ex: The tech sector employs thousands in Dublin.

services.en: systems that supply what people need
services.ex: The area needs better water services.

set.ex: We hit the goal set by the manager.

several.en: more than two but not many

shows.ex: Her favourite shows are about cooking.

small.ex: She runs a small shop in Cork.

so.en: to such a degree; even so = despite that
so.ex: It was so cold that we stayed home.
so.zh: 如此；（even so：儘管如此；so many：這麼多）

sounded.ex: Doctors sounded the alarm about rising flu cases.
sounded.zh: 發出（sound the alarm：發出警訊）

spending.ex: Government spending on roads went up.

spent.en: used money to pay for something
spent.ex: They have spent their savings on a new car.
spent.zh: 花費了（spend 的過去分詞）

spoke.ex: The doctor spoke to reporters after the meeting.

stagnant.ex: Wages have been stagnant for years.

example.en: Wages have remained stagnant for years.

noteHi.exampleTr: वर्षों से वेतन जस का तस है।

noteJa.exampleTr: 賃金は何年も停滞している。
noteJa.usage: stagnant wages、remain stagnant の形が多い。

stand.en: stand by: keep a promise or decision
stand.ex: We stand by our promise to cut fees.

streaming.en: watching films or shows online without downloading
streaming.ex: Streaming has changed how families watch TV.

stressed.ex: The doctor stressed the need for rest.

subscriptions.ex: Many people forget about old subscriptions.

subsequently.ex: He was subsequently given a new role.

substantial.ex: There has been a substantial rise in rents.

example.en: The council made a substantial investment in parks.
example.zh: 市議會對公園進行了大筆投資。

note.usage: 學術寫作常用來取代 big/large；常接 amount, increase, number, cost。

noteEn.usage: A formal word for 'big': 'a substantial increase'.

noteEs.exampleTr: El ayuntamiento hizo una inversión considerable en parques.
noteEs.usage: Sustituye a big/large en textos académicos: a substantial increase.

noteHi.exampleTr: परिषद ने पार्कों में भारी निवेश किया।
noteHi.usage: अकादमिक लेखन में big/large की जगह; substantial increase/amount आम हैं।

noteJa.exampleTr: 市議会は公園に多額の投資をした。
noteJa.usage: 学術的な文章で big/large の代わりに使う。a substantial increase など。

noteKo.usage: 학술 글에서 big/large 대신 사용; a substantial increase 등.

support.ex: Young people need support to find work.

surging.ex: Ticket sales are surging ahead of the festival.

tds.en: members of the Dáil, Ireland's parliament
tds.ja: TD（アイルランド下院議員）

television.en: programmes on TV; the TV industry
television.ex: She works in television as a writer.

tg.ja: TG4（アイルランド語テレビ局）

then.ex: Then the trains will be faster.

thereafter.ex: He left school at 16 and thereafter worked on farms.

therefore.ex: It was late; therefore, we took a taxi.

this.en: the thing here or just said

time.en: at a time: in one go
time.ex: Read the book one chapter at a time.

told.ex: She told her boss about the problem.

tuesday.ex: The meeting is on Tuesday morning.

tv.ex: The TV is in the kitchen.

example.zh: 健全的公共服務是公平社會的基礎。

note.usage: 常用於抽象事物：A underpins B 表示 A 是 B 的基礎；多見於正式寫作。

noteEn.meaning: to support something and make it possible.
noteEn.usage: Formal: 'A underpins B' means A is the base of B.

noteEs.exampleTr: Unos servicios públicos sólidos sustentan una sociedad justa.
noteEs.meaning: sustentar; ser la base de algo.
noteEs.usage: Registro formal: A underpins B = A es la base de B.

noteHi.exampleTr: मज़बूत सार्वजनिक सेवाएँ एक न्यायपूर्ण समाज का आधार हैं।
noteHi.meaning: किसी चीज़ को आधार या सहारा देना।

paragraphs: Ireland's film and TV makers are worried. The Government plans to cut money for RTÉ by €20 million. RTÉ is the national TV and radio company.
Many small companies make shows for RTÉ. Their group is called Screen Producers Ireland. Its boss, Susan Kirby, spoke to TDs on Tuesday.
She said the money helps companies plan for the future. She asked the Government to keep its promise. She also wants money for several years, not one year at a time.
The group wants big streaming companies like Netflix and Disney to pay a fee. This money could pay for Irish shows.
Film and TV work is big business in Ireland. Companies spent €544 million on making shows last year.

政府打算把給RTÉ的經費削減兩千萬歐元。
RTÉ是國家電視和廣播公司。
許多小公司替RTÉ製作節目。
他們的團體叫做愛爾蘭影視製作人協會。
協會負責人蘇珊．柯比週二向國會議員發言。
她說這筆錢能幫助公司為未來做規劃。
她要求政府信守承諾。
她也希望經費能一次撥好幾年，而不是一年一年給。
該團體希望Netflix和迪士尼等大型串流公司支付一筆費用。
這筆錢可以用來資助愛爾蘭的節目。
影視產業在愛爾蘭是大生意。
去年各公司花了五億四千四百萬歐元製作節目。

paragraphs: Independent film and television producers in Ireland have said they are worried about a plan to cut €20 million from the funding of RTÉ, the national broadcaster. The cut was announced after the recent budget.

Screen Producers Ireland represents more than 200 independent companies. On Tuesday, its chief executive, Susan Kirby, told a committee of TDs and senators that RTÉ money gives the sector certainty and helps companies plan their work.
She also said funding for TG4, the Irish-language channel, has not grown. Many Irish-language producers work outside Dublin, so the problem hits regional areas hardest.

The group asked the Government to keep its funding promise and then give RTÉ money for several years at a time. It also wants a fee on large streaming services such as Netflix and Disney to pay for Irish programmes. Ms Kirby said this would not be a charge on the public.
The sector is worth more than €1 billion a year to the economy. Spending on production reached €544 million in 2025, up 26% on the year before.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭的獨立影視製作人表示，他們對削減國家廣播公司RTÉ兩千萬歐元經費的計畫感到擔憂。
這項刪減是在最近的預算案公布後宣布的。
愛爾蘭影視製作人協會代表超過兩百家獨立公司。
週二，協會執行長蘇珊．柯比告訴一個由眾議員和參議員組成的委員會，RTÉ的經費為產業帶來確定性，也幫助公司規劃工作。
她也說，愛爾蘭語頻道TG4的經費一直沒有增加。
許多愛爾蘭語製作人在都柏林以外工作，因此這個問題對地方地區的打擊最大。
該團體要求政府信守經費承諾，之後再一次撥給RTÉ好幾年的經費。
他們也希望向Netflix和迪士尼等大型串流服務收取費用，用來資助愛爾蘭節目。
柯比女士說，這不會是向大眾收取的費用。
這個產業每年為經濟貢獻超過十億歐元。
二〇二五年的製作支出達到五億四千四百萬歐元，比前一年成長26%。

paragraphs: Independent film and television producers have voiced concern over a planned €20 million reduction in funding for RTÉ, the national broadcaster, which was announced in the wake of the recent budget.

Susan Kirby, chief executive of Screen Producers Ireland, which represents more than 200 independent production companies, told the Oireachtas Committee on Budgetary Oversight that RTÉ funding provides the certainty the sector needs to plan ahead.
She warned that money for TG4, the Irish-language broadcaster, has effectively stalled. Because most Irish-language producers are based in the regions, the impact would be felt far beyond Dublin.

The organisation is urging the Government to honour its existing commitment to RTÉ and then move to multi-annual funding, in line with the European Media Freedom Act. It has also renewed its call for a content levy on major streaming platforms such as Netflix and Disney. Ms Kirby argued that subscription prices have already risen without such a levy, so it would not be a charge on the public.

Officials told the committee that the independent sector contributes over €1 billion to the economy each year, and production spending rose by 26% to €544 million in 2025. The cap on film tax relief has also been raised to €125 million.
sentZh: 獨立影視製作人對國家廣播公司RTÉ經費計畫削減兩千萬歐元一事表達關切，這項刪減是在最近的預算案之後宣布的。
代表超過兩百家獨立製作公司的愛爾蘭影視製作人協會執行長蘇珊．柯比，向國會預算監督委員會表示，RTÉ的經費提供了產業提前規劃所需的確定性。
她警告，給愛爾蘭語廣播公司TG4的經費實際上已經停滯。
由於大多數愛爾蘭語製作人都設在地方，影響將遠遠超出都柏林。
該組織敦促政府兌現對RTÉ的既有承諾，接著依照《歐洲媒體自由法》改採多年期撥款。
他們也再次呼籲對Netflix和迪士尼等主要串流平台徵收內容稅。
柯比女士主張，即使沒有這種稅，訂閱價格也早已上漲，所以這不會是向大眾收費。
官員告訴委員會，獨立製作產業每年為經濟貢獻超過十億歐元，二〇二五年製作支出成長26%，達到五億四千四百萬歐元。
電影稅收減免的上限也已提高到一億兩千五百萬歐元。

paragraphs: Ireland's independent screen sector has sounded the alarm over a proposed €20 million cut to RTÉ's funding, a measure unveiled in the aftermath of the recent budget.

Appearing before the Oireachtas Committee on Budgetary Oversight, Susan Kirby, who heads Screen Producers Ireland, stressed that the broadcaster's funding underpins the predictability on which more than 200 member companies depend.
She cautioned that support for TG4 has all but ground to a halt, and since Irish-language producers are predominantly regional, the repercussions would ripple well beyond the capital.

The body is pressing the Government to stand by its existing pledge and subsequently adopt multi-annual funding, consistent with the European Media Freedom Act. It has also revived its campaign for a content levy on streaming giants such as Netflix and Disney, contending that subscription fees have climbed regardless, so the levy would not burden ordinary viewers.

The committee heard that the sector generates in excess of €1 billion annually, with production expenditure surging 26% to €544 million in 2025, bolstered by a film tax relief cap now set at €125 million.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭獨立影視產業對RTÉ經費擬削減兩千萬歐元一事發出警訊，這項措施是在最近的預算案之後公布的。
愛爾蘭影視製作人協會負責人蘇珊．柯比出席國會預算監督委員會時強調，這家廣播公司的經費支撐著兩百多家會員公司所仰賴的可預測性。
她提醒，對TG4的支持幾乎已經停擺，而且由於愛爾蘭語製作人主要分布在地方，衝擊將波及首都以外的廣大地區。
該組織正施壓政府履行既有承諾，隨後依照《歐洲媒體自由法》採用多年期撥款。
它也重啟對Netflix和迪士尼等串流巨頭徵收內容稅的倡議，主張訂閱費無論如何都已上漲，因此這項稅不會加重一般觀眾的負擔。
委員會獲悉，該產業每年創造超過十億歐元的產值，二〇二五年製作支出大增26%至五億四千四百萬歐元，這得益於目前設定為一億兩千五百萬歐元的電影稅收減免上限。

paragraphs: A proposed €20 million reduction in RTÉ's funding, announced subsequent to the recent budget, has prompted substantial concern among Ireland's independent film and television producers.

Addressing the Oireachtas Committee on Budgetary Oversight, Susan Kirby of Screen Producers Ireland maintained that stable public funding is fundamental to long-term planning for the more than 200 companies the organisation represents.

She further noted that funding for TG4 has remained largely stagnant. Consequently, given that Irish-language production is concentrated outside Dublin, the cut would have disproportionate regional consequences.

The organisation advocates that the Government fulfil its current commitment and thereafter introduce multi-annual funding, in accordance with the European Media Freedom Act. Furthermore, it has reiterated its proposal for a content levy on major streaming providers such as Netflix and Disney. Nevertheless, it acknowledged official concerns that consumers might bear the cost, while arguing that subscriptions have risen irrespective of any levy.

According to evidence presented to the committee, the sector contributes in excess of €1 billion annually, and production expenditure increased by 26% to €544 million in 2025. Its continued growth may therefore be contingent upon predictable funding.
sentZh: 在最近的預算案之後宣布的RTÉ經費擬削減兩千萬歐元，已在愛爾蘭獨立影視製作人之間引發相當大的擔憂。
愛爾蘭影視製作人協會的蘇珊．柯比在國會預算監督委員會發言時主張，穩定的公共經費對該組織所代表的兩百多家公司的長期規劃至關重要。
她進一步指出，TG4的經費大致停滯不前。
因此，由於愛爾蘭語製作集中在都柏林以外，這項刪減將對地方造成不成比例的影響。
該組織主張政府履行目前的承諾，此後依照《歐洲媒體自由法》實施多年期撥款。
此外，它重申了對Netflix和迪士尼等主要串流業者徵收內容稅的提議。
儘管如此，它承認官方擔心消費者可能承擔成本，同時主張無論有無這項稅，訂閱費都已上漲。
根據提交給委員會的資料，該產業每年貢獻超過十億歐元，二〇二五年製作支出成長26%，達到五億四千四百萬歐元。
因此，其持續成長可能取決於可預測的經費。
